Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”789 6 Then I said, “Ah, Lord10 Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”1112 7 But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.1314 8 Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.151617 9 Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.18192021 10 Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”222324 11 Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”2526 12 Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”27282930 13 Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”3132 14 Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land33.3435 15 For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.3637 16 I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.38 17 “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.39 18 For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land40—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.414243 19 They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”

BABYLON , KINGDOM OF called “the land of the Chaldeans” (Jeremiah 24:5; Ezek, 12:13), was an extensive province in Central Asia along the valley of the Tigris from the Persian Gulf northward for some 300 miles. It was famed for its fertility and its riches. Its capital was the city of Babylon, a great commercial centre (Ezekiel 17:4; Isaiah 43:14). Babylonia was divided into the two districts of Accad in the north, and Summer (probably the Shinar of the Old Testament) in the south.… [Reviewer: condense Easton's entry as needed.]
